text:
sara_prod: Quick pre-change-window check — we have a planned traffic shift to dedicated pool at 22:00 UTC and a freeze starting 21:30 UTC. Sharing what I need from each owner: canaries, rollback commands, pin approvals, and monitoring links.

deploy-bot: scheduled deployment: canary -> dedicated-pool at 22:00 UTC. CI checks green. (id: db-deploy-184200) :robot_face:

mike_oncall: I can take oncall for the window. I want explicit rollback cmds and the SLO guardrails. Also, confirm that merges get locked at 21:30.

sara_prod: yes lock will be applied. @mike_oncall I'll post the lock command in #eng-infra but assume no new merges after 21:30.

leanne_pm: From product side: approved pin for api service to v2.14.2 for the weekend. Approval record: jira/RP-423. We want a gradual 5% -> 25% -> 100% traffic ramp over 30m.

david_eng: Pin applied in deploy-config: `service.api.image: api:v2.14.2` and rollout policy set to `traffic-schedule: [5,25,100]` in the canary job. Paste below the rollback/restore cmds I keep in ops runbook:

```
# rollback to previous stable
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/api --to-revision=12
# force traffic back to stable pool
curl -X POST https://infra.internal/api/traffic-shift -d '{"pool":"stable","percent":100}' -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

chris_release: added a short-circuit: if 95th >= 1.5x baseline for error rate in 10m, auto-sunset canary and trigger rollback tag `rb/auto-184200`. Monitoring rule is in grafana: dashboards/infra/api-canary.

mike_oncall: I added paging for cpu and 5xx alerts to my rotation. Also added a manual checklist for oncall: steps to watch, when to escalate to eng-sre, and contact for legal if data-regressed.

sara_prod: freeze policy reminder: branch protection + changelog requirement + deploy approvals enabled at 21:30. Exceptions require @leanne_pm + @david_eng + @mike_oncall.

leanne_pm: I'm granting an explicit exemption for the bundling hotfix (if it shows up) — will comment in the PR. Otherwise no merges.

david_eng: One more operational note: KV-cache warmup for the dedicated pool started 20:45 UTC. Should be at ~80% by 21:45. If warmup < 60% at 21:50 we abort traffic shift.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started: db-deploy-184200 -> pods 3/3 recreating. Logs: https://deploys.internal/db-deploy-184200/logs

mike_oncall: saw spike in one of the canary pods at 22:02 (latency 95th ~ 1.2x). Watching. No error-rate increase yet.

chris_release: reminder: fallback plan has 2 stages — 1) cut traffic to stable pool (script above), 2) rollback image if errors persist. We'll execute stage 1 at 22:07 if 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m.

sara_prod: tagging final readiness: approvals from @leanne_pm and @david_eng present, oncall = @mike_oncall, infra warmup ok. Proceeding with scheduled traffic shift. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: traffic-shift job triggered at 22:10 UTC. status: ramping 5% -> 25%. details: https://deploys.internal/db-deploy-184200/traffic

david_eng: rolling back to stable now (manual trigger) to test the rollback script in prod sandbox: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/api --to-revision=12` — ran at 22:11 in sandbox only, looks good.

mike_oncall: seeing expected metrics. will escalate if error rates cross thresholds.

sara_prod: final note — freeze enforced, logs and post-mortem template shared at https://docs.internal/release/runbook. If anything unexpected, tag this thread and ping @eng-sre.

chris_release: :shipit: good to go.

sara_prod: closing this check — will post a brief release note after full ramp. thanks everyone.
